description: This PHP source file defines a class 'NavigationBarTester' within the 'Step\Acceptance' namespace. The class provides methods to automate interactions with a CRM application's navigation bar in different viewports (desktop, tablet, mobile). It includes functions to click on the home button, user menu items, and various menu items based on the current design breakpoint. The code is used for acceptance testing to verify UI navigation behavior across responsive layouts.

classes.name: NavigationBarTester
classes.description: A class for automating navigation bar interactions in acceptance tests, supporting different device breakpoints.

methods.name: clickHome
methods.description: Clicks on the home button or navbar brand, depending on the viewport size.

methods.name: clickUserMenuItem
methods.description: Selects a menu item from the user's global links menu based on the design breakpoint.

methods.name: clickAllMenuItem
methods.description: Navigates to a module by clicking an item from the top all menu, handling different layouts per breakpoint.

methods.name: clickCurrentMenuItem
methods.description: Selects a menu item from the current module's dropdown, based on device viewport.
